note: Hero mascot takes for the German lead, the Brezel (DE14), made as the concha's are (content/art/mascot/takes.json). npm run mascot -- --lang de re-encodes every take into content/de/art/mascot/takes/ and publishes the two in "use" to public/mascot-de/. Raw takes are cached in content/.cache/mascot-de/ and downloaded again from url when missing. A take in use also needs a cutout: Higgsfield’s Video Background Remover run on the raw take (1 credit), which comes back on black.

startFrame.recipe: cutout of content/art/de/cast/brezel-front.webp (image_background_remover), 600 px tall, centred, bottom 110 px from the foot of a 1024 px square of #fff8ec

references.note: side and back panels cropped from content/art/de/cast/brezel-sheet.webp (top row, third and fourth), given as image_references so a full turn shows her faceless back

takes.name: idle-t1
takes.prompt: Soft 3D clay-toy stop-motion animation of the Brezel pretzel girl from the image. Static locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts; she stays fully in frame. Plain flat warm cream background that never changes, no props, no text. Her body is one solid matte plasticine pretzel: the dough loops stay knotted on top of her head the whole time, the little sage-green felt Alpine hat with its lilac feather stays perched on the knot, the white salt crystals stay where they are, and her size and design never change. She starts and ends in exactly the pose of the image, facing the camera. Idle loop: she stands in place breathing gently, her round body rising and squashing softly, she blinks, sways a little from side to side as if humming a happy tune, gives a big warm smile, then settles back into the starting pose. Calm and subtle.
